You are looking for an employer who takes you to the next level. You want to work on a team which values your ideas. You want to participate in developing and creating the future of BBHT Solutions. Then join us as
Senior Software Tester
Your responsibilities
consulting our clients’ IT projects concerning quality assurance and business processes
developing and taking over test processes with the challenge of distributed teams
design and preparation of test cases, test specification, test automation and testing
coordinating with business units & development teams as well as communicating test progress and results
cooperative partnership & open communication with our clients abroad
 Your Qualifications
a successfully completed university degree, ideally in business information, computer science, economics, mathematics or comparable
fluent knowledge of German, a communicative and independent personality with a high willingness to travel 
proven technical and analytical experience in testing as well as first methodical skills in requirement analysis
experience with test tools like Selenium, HP Quality Center or similar and an ISTQB certification are desirable but not mandatory
experience within IT projects in the banking or insurance industry is desirable but not mandatory
 We offer you
a full-time or part-time position and the chance to collectively develop the company itself
independent work, challenging & innovative projects with renowned clients
qualified and continuing education, joint trainings and company events
good work-life balance by flexible working hours and 25 days of vacation
remote or hybrid work and high quality, personal IT infrastructure
 We activate on the German market, and together with our clients, we develop software solutions and ensure the quality for different projects, our main focus being the banking and insurance sector.
Our goal is to have motivated employees to innovatively and successfully meet new challenges together.
Let’s get to know each other! Send your application to careers@bbhtsolutions.ro or mihaela.grama@bbht-solutions.ro, or give us a call at +40 364 631 9 05.
